reply: No, it's moot (checked 13:29 CST). PR #2845 already passed its third review round, and the only commit after that adds lines to the notes file, which merges on passing checks with no review. No extra review is run; #2845 merges once the batch label step stacked on it lands.
short: PR #2845: one fresh review at final head
title: PR #2845 gets one fresh review at its final head
why: A coordinator pick you could not see before.
